dedupe_keys.name: fcc form 477 fixed broadband deployment data census block 2015 2021

description: Until the Broadband Data Collection replaced it, every facilities-based broadband provider in the United States had to file FCC Form 477 twice a year, listing the census blocks where it offered or could offer internet access faster than 200 kbps in at least one direction. The FCC open data portal publishes the fixed deployment data from these filings as one table per filing round, from December 2015 to June 2021, each row giving the provider, its holding company and FCC registration number, the census block, the technology code (DSL, cable, fibre, fixed wireless, satellite and others), consumer and business availability and the maximum advertised download and upload speeds; companion provider, area and geography tables summarise them. The June 2021 table alone has about 78 million rows. Coverage: all US states and territories, census block level, twice-yearly snapshots. Format and access: tables through the Socrata API and CSV export, free as US government data. Caveats: a block counts as served if one location could be served, so availability is overstated; the series ended in 2021 and is superseded by the National Broadband Map. Simulation uses: an inventory of fixed networks by technology and provider for hazard exposure, resilience and equity analysis of broadband, and historical baselines for deployment. Related records: the Arcep fibre deployment data are a French counterpart.
